title: 005. Top K Frequent Elements
prompt: Given an integer array `nums` and an integer `k`, return the `k` most frequent elements. You may return the answer in any order. Achieve `O(N)` time using Bucket Sort by frequency.
invariant: freq_buckets[count].append(num)  →  scan buckets from N down to 1

hints.title: Mental Model & Intuition
hints.content: A heap takes `O(N log K)`. Notice that no element's frequency can exceed `N = len(nums)`. Create `N + 1` buckets where index `f` stores all numbers that appeared exactly `f` times!

hints.title: Pattern Identification
hints.content: Hash Map frequency count + Bounded Bucket Sort (`buckets = [[] for _ in range(len(nums) + 1)]`).

hints.title: Algorithmic Invariant
hints.content: After populating `buckets[freq].append(num)`, iterate `freq` backwards from `len(nums)` down to `1`, collecting numbers until `len(res) == k`.

hints.title: Edge Cases & Scaffolding
hints.content: When `len(nums) == 1` and `k == 1`, `freq` is `1`, so `buckets` must have length `len(nums) + 1` (indices `0..N`).
